story.title: Today's goal: lines 7 and 8 warm and steady, with 怨恨 clear
story.content: Today: lines 7 and 8 sound warm and natural. Line 7 is built in three chunks: 我从一岁起 / 每年都去台湾 / 看望祖父. Line 8 in four: 他失去了那么多 / 可是我从来没有看到他 / 有一点 / 怨恨. No progress file yet: tap "Send progress to my coach" in the app's Progress screen and paste it in the chat so I can tailor tomorrow.

pronunciationTip:
PRONUNCIATION CLINIC. (1) 一 changes tone: in 一岁 the dictionary tone is yīsuì, but before the 4th tone 岁 it is spoken yí (yí suì). In 有一点 it is spoken yì before the 3rd tone 点 (yìdiǎn). (2) Third tones together: 我 wǒ and 有 yǒu are 3rd tones. In 有一点, 有 dips and 点 dips, so keep it light and flowing. Say 可是 kěshì smoothly. (3) yuàn and the ü sounds: 怨 yuàn starts with ü: round your lips as for "oo", then say "ee" without moving them, then "-an". Contrast: 怨恨 yuànhèn vs 看望 kànwàng (both 4th tones, but yuàn needs the rounded ü). Also 去 qù: soft "ch" with spread lips, vs 起 qǐ. Contrast: 失去 shīqù vs 每年 měinián. Neutral tone: 了 le light and short in 失去了. DELIVERY: line 7: gentle and warm, pause after 起 (short) and after 台湾 (tiny). Stress 每年 and 看望. Line 8: pause after 那么多 (a full breath), then stress 从来没有, and slow down on 怨恨 as the key word. Pace: about 5 seconds for line 7, 7 seconds for line 8.
**Daily run-through:** read all 13 lines of the main speech aloud once (about 90 sec), then listen to full_speech_normal.mp3 once. Practice plan (10–15 min): listen to today's shadowing.mp3 (3 min); shadow each chunk twice, then each whole line twice; record lines 7 and 8 in the app's Speak coach and compare; listen to full_speech_normal.mp3 once.

quiz.question: Review from Day 6: in 我的祖母赵一荻，一直陪在他身边, how do you say 一 in 赵一荻 and in 一直?
quiz.correct: Zhào Yīdí keeps yī because it is in a name; 一直 is spoken yìzhí.
